description: Runs any registered model on its inputs, or binds its inputs to the data catalog first (as of a date, or the latest), and returns the canonical result: the validated inputs, the outputs, the warnings and the manifest of every source read. Data whose terms do not let it reach an AI assistant is never used.

inputSchema.description: A run of any model. Any of as_of, vintage, profile, concepts or parameters binds the model's data first; without them the model runs on its inputs alone.

as_of.description: Bind the model's data as published on this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

concepts.description: Field names mapped to catalog concept ids that replace their bindings' concepts.

inputs.description: The model's inputs, as its input schema (describe_model) gives them. With a bind, each one given replaces the value the data would supply.

model_id.description: A model id, or an alias of one.

parameters.description: Values of the bound concepts' parameters.

profile.description: The named set of bindings to read; 'default' binds the latest data.

vintage.description: The vintage policy of every binding, in place of their own.

inputSchema.title: run_model: inputs

name: run_model

outputSchema.description: The run's result as canonical JSON (RFC 8785): the validated inputs and outputs, the warnings and the manifest.
outputSchema.title: run_model: result

description: Searches the registered economics and finance models by words in their ids, titles, tags, domains and summaries, best match first, or lists every model of a domain. Each entry gives the model's id, title, summary, domain, cost class and whether it can bind its inputs to data.

domain.description: Only the models of this domain.

limit.description: The most entries a search returns, best first.

query.description: Words to look for in each model's id, title, tags, domain and summary. Without it, every model of the domain (or every model) is listed, sorted by id.

name: search_models

outputSchema.description: The models found, best first, or every model listed, sorted by id.
outputSchema.title: search_models: result
